user.title: Connect Norish
user.description: Enter your Norish server URL and API key. Optionally provide your Norish login credentials to enable automatic API key renewal when the key expires.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Norish
reconfigure.description: Update your Norish URL, API key, or login credentials for automatic renewal. Leave the API key or password empty to keep the current one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Norish
reauth_confirm.description: Your Norish API key has expired. Enter a new key. You can also update your Norish login credentials here to fix or enable automatic API key renewal.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed or timed out. Please check the URL.

init.title: Norish Options
init.description: Adjust how often Norish polls for updates. Lower values mean more frequent updates but use more API requests.

add_recipe_to_groceries.name: Add recipe to shopping list
add_recipe_to_groceries.description: Put a recipe's ingredients on the Norish shopping list: by ID, by name, or the recipes planned on a date (default today).

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: Norish recipe ID. Leave empty to use the planned recipes.

recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.description: Search Norish for this recipe (e.g. from a voice command); the best match is used.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale the amounts to this number of servings.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the planned recipes. Default: today.

slot.name: Meal
slot.description: Only this meal of the day.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days starting at the date, e.g. 7 for the whole week.

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Import a recipe from a web page into Norish. Norish imports it in the background; a norish_change event with kind recipes.imported or recipes.failed follows.

force_ai.name: Use AI
force_ai.description: Let Norish's AI read the page, also when the page has structured recipe data.

realtime_unavailable.title: Norish realtime updates are not available
realtime_unavailable.description: Home Assistant could not open Norish's WebSocket at {url}, so changes only arrive with the regular updates. If Norish runs behind a reverse proxy, make sure it forwards WebSocket upgrades on /trpc (for nginx: proxy_http_version 1.1 and the Upgrade/Connection headers). This message disappears as soon as the connection works.
